EngineeringMomentRecord.title: EngineeringMomentRecord
EngineeringMomentRecord.description: The sealed Engineering Moment record: content plus its SHA-256 content address (the shareable identity).

EngineeringMomentContent.title: EngineeringMomentContent
EngineeringMomentContent.description: The shareable/replayable collaboration unit: world snapshot, agent state, human state, visual state, timeline position, evidence, scenario, and available actions — all opaque, tenant-scoped references.

AiExperienceRecordVersion.title: AiExperienceRecordVersion
AiExperienceRecordVersion.description: Exact record version admitted by this release (1).

AiSessionId.title: AiSessionId
AiSessionId.description: Collaboration session identity: "session:" followed by a lowercase slug (W010 grammar).

AiTenantId.title: AiTenantId
AiTenantId.description: Tenant scope of an AI-collaboration record: "tenant:" followed by a lowercase slug (W009 grammar).

AiPrincipalId.title: AiPrincipalId
AiPrincipalId.description: Collaboration participant principal: "principal:" followed by a lowercase slug (W009 grammar).

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).

ProjectedReference.title: ProjectedReference
ProjectedReference.description: Opaque, tenant-scoped, exact-revision reference to projected kernel state; never an embedded kernel object.

ProjectedWorldEntityRef.title: ProjectedWorldEntityRef
ProjectedWorldEntityRef.description: Exact-revision reference to a materialized world-model entity (W002 grammar; digest of its canonical JSON).

OpaqueScopeId.title: OpaqueScopeId
OpaqueScopeId.description: Opaque scoping identifier (tenant/workspace/project/participant); bounded, neutral charset.

ProjectedWorldRelationRef.title: ProjectedWorldRelationRef
ProjectedWorldRelationRef.description: Exact-revision reference to a materialized world-model relation (W002 grammar; digest of its canonical JSON).

ProjectedWorldEventRef.title: ProjectedWorldEventRef
ProjectedWorldEventRef.description: Exact-revision reference to a world-model event (W002 grammar; digest of its canonical JSON).

ProjectedAgentRef.title: ProjectedAgentRef
ProjectedAgentRef.description: Exact-revision reference to a registered agent (W003 grammar; digest of its registration canonical JSON).

AgentId.title: AgentId
AgentId.description: Registered agent identifier: "agent:" followed by a lowercase slug.

ProjectedEvidenceRef.title: ProjectedEvidenceRef
ProjectedEvidenceRef.description: Reference to an evidence record by its content-addressed identity (W006: the SHA-256 digest is the id).

ProjectedCapabilityRef.title: ProjectedCapabilityRef
ProjectedCapabilityRef.description: Exact-revision reference to a registered capability manifest (W007 grammar; digest of its canonical JSON).

MomentParticipantState.title: MomentParticipantState
MomentParticipantState.description: One participant state captured in an Engineering Moment: presence, focus, and whether the participant holds control.

PeerParticipantKind.title: PeerParticipantKind
PeerParticipantKind.description: Collaboration peer participant kind — the W011 ParticipantKind subset of humans and agents (peers with typed roles).

AiAgentId.title: AiAgentId
AiAgentId.description: Registered agent identity: "agent:" followed by a lowercase slug (W003 grammar).

AgentPresenceState.title: AgentPresenceState
AgentPresenceState.description: Presence state of a collaboration participant (W010 vocabulary): joining, present, idle, or the terminal left.

FocusTarget.title: FocusTarget
FocusTarget.description: What a participant focuses on — the W010 collaboration subject grammar (world entity or exact-revision action proposal), mirrored and parity-pinned.

WorldEntityTarget.title: WorldEntityTarget
WorldEntityTarget.description: World-entity focus target: an opaque W002 entity id (referenced, never embedded).

ActionProposalFocusTarget.title: ActionProposalFocusTarget
ActionProposalFocusTarget.description: Action-proposal focus target: an exact-revision W003 proposal reference (referenced, never embedded).

ActionProposalTarget.title: ActionProposalTarget
ActionProposalTarget.description: Exact-revision action-proposal reference (W003 ProposalReference shape): message id plus the SHA-256 digest of the canonical proposal.

ExperienceGraphReference.title: ExperienceGraphReference
ExperienceGraphReference.description: Reference to the W011 Experience Graph that is an Engineering Moment visual state (digest only — never embedded).

MomentExperienceGraphKind.title: MomentExperienceGraphKind
MomentExperienceGraphKind.description: The W011 Experience Graph kind of a moment visual state (W011 vocabulary).

TimelinePosition.title: TimelinePosition
TimelinePosition.description: One timeline/replay position: a W010 event-log stream coordinate (inclusive last-applied sequence; 0 denotes the stream start).

EventStreamId.title: EventStreamId
EventStreamId.description: Opaque event stream identity: the unit of total order; every event in a stream carries a contiguous 1-based sequence.

ScenarioReference.title: ScenarioReference
ScenarioReference.description: Opaque scenario reference — the world scenario an Engineering Moment belongs to.

InteractionIntentKind.title: InteractionIntentKind
InteractionIntentKind.description: Kind of a typed interaction intent — a closed, sorted subset of the Epoch Universal interactions.
